skill.summary: Build a safe, progressive bodyweight strength ladder with movement regressions, progression rules, weekly review prompts, and deload triggers — no equipment...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Bodyweight Strength Progression.

- Provides a structured, equipment-free bodyweight strength training plan with clear movement assessments and progressions.
- Includes customizable progression ladders for push, pull, squat, hinge, and core movements.
- Features weekly planning, progression rules, and safety checkpoints to ensure gradual and safe advancement.
- Offers guidance on deload triggers, injury considerations, and 4-week review templates.
- Designed for all levels, from complete beginners to those seeking advanced bodyweight strength challenges.
